scheme_name: NDRI Institute Scholarship For M.Sc. And Ph.d
other_conditions: Student must be of Indian nationality as defined in the Constitution of India or domiciled in India
Student must not be receiving any other scholarship, fellowship or financial assistance from any other source
Must register for all prescribed courses each semester (research is considered a course)
Must maintain an aggregate of at least 65% (or 64.5% considered as 65%) in the previous semester to be eligible for the next period
Students on conduct probation are not eligible for scholarship payments
Scholarship terminates if the student is removed from the institute rolls or completes the study
Students participating in a collaborative programme are eligible only after returning and re‑joining the institute
In‑service Ph.D. students must be employed in the ICAR/SAU system and the third degree must not be from the same institute
benefits_summary: Eligible Master’s students receive Rs. 7,560 per month, Doctoral students receive Rs. 10,500 per month (in‑service Ph.D. students Rs. 1,000 per month), and a contingency grant of up to Rs. 12,000 for Master’s or Rs. 30,000 for Doctoral programmes is provided.
documents_required: Acceptance of the award in the prescribed proforma
Undertaking to follow the rules and regulations as per conditions governing the Scholarship in the prescribed proforma
